vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: equity-valuation-framework
Version: 1.0.1

The skill bundle is benign. Its primary purpose is to process pre-fetched financial data and generate a structured equity valuation report. The `SKILL.md` explicitly states that 'This skill does not fetch data,' mitigating data exfiltration concerns from this specific skill. All instructions for the AI agent in `SKILL.md` and `agents/openai.yaml` are strictly aligned with financial analysis and report generation, showing no evidence of prompt injection attempts, malicious execution, persistence mechanisms, or data exfiltration.

llm.summary: This instruction-only skill is internally consistent: it transforms already-fetched financial data into a standardized valuation report and requests no installs, credentials, or out-of-scope access.

dimensions.detail: The name and description state a valuation playbook; the SKILL.md only requires a structured input bundle (financials, price history, peers, macro, etc.) and references upstream data-providing skills. There are no unrelated environment variables, binaries, or install steps requested, so capability matches purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to validating input, running valuation modules (Multiples, DCF, sector adaptations), producing scenarios/confidence, and returning a report. The skill explicitly says it does NOT fetch data and does not instruct the agent to read arbitrary filesystem paths, environment variables, or external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — this is instruction-only. That minimizes disk writes and execution of external code; risk from installation is negligible.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. It relies on upstream data-providing skills (which may require credentials), but this skill itself does not request or handle secrets.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and normal autonomous invocation settings. The skill does not request persistent system presence or modifications to other skills or system-wide settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk because it only defines how to transform already-provided financial data into a valuation report and asks for no installs or secrets. Before installing/use, ensure (1) the upstream data sources you provide (vnstock, nso, etc.) are trusted and have appropriate credentials handled separately, (2) the agent is not implicitly granted additional data-fetching permissions you didn't intend, and (3) you validate the input bundle the skill will consume (freshness and completeness) so outputs aren't misleading. If you prefer stricter control, consider disabling autonomous invocation for the agent or reviewing any orchestration that will supply the input bundle.
